stem: How does Uncle Dock respond to his sister when she expresses concern about Sophie's safety?

options.label: F
options.text: He reminds her that they are going to see Bompie.

options.label: G
options.text: He tells her that they need Sophie to help on the boat.

options.label: H
options.text: He encourages her to join them on the trip.

options.label: J
options.text: He provides her with a list of the equipment on the boat.
